description: Full detail for one Phillips lot: work title, maker, lot number, realized price (hammer plus buyer's premium), hammer price, estimate range, currency, the sale it appeared in and its date, plus the catalogue image. Takes the `lot_id` from phillips_results_search.

lot_id.description: Phillips lot id (the `lot_id` / objectNumber from phillips_results_search), e.g. "233345".

slug.description: Optional artist slug for the URL, e.g. "banksy". Decorative — any value resolves the same lot; omit to use a placeholder.

name: phillips_lot_details
title: Phillips Lot Details
